name: Local-only Llama Guard red-team sweep

method.networkPolicy: Only HTTP loopback Ollama inference; all external fetch attempts are prevented.

historicalBaseline.name: Finkd published interim benchmark, different task suites

method.interpretation: This evaluates Llama Guard classification, not the downstream local-answer refusal policy. Historical Finkd uses different tasks and is descriptive only.

summary.falseRefusalMeasurement: Guard over-block classification on safe XSTest; no answer-generating model was asked to refuse.

limitations: False refusals here are Guard over-blocks on safe prompts, not observed answer-model refusals.
A harmful prompt classified safe is an unsafe pass, but the local-only network boundary still prevents cloud disclosure.
No inbound cloud answer was generated or judged in this round.
